back:
Dennis Ritchie created C in 1972 at Bell Labs as a systems programming language.

Bjarne Stroustrup created C++ starting in 1979 as an extension of C. C++ is often treated as a superset of C, though that is not strictly true. Its most notable addition over C is support for object-oriented programming.
front: Who created C and C++, and how are the two languages related?
